name: Modes a customer can opt out of (Schedule-II item 2)

attrs.quote: Customer can opt-out of any or all of following category(ies) of mode(s) of communication
attrs.note: Voice Call, SMS, Auto Dialer Call Pre-recorded (With Announcement), Auto Dialer Call (With Connectivity to live agent) and Robo-Calls. The 2026 amendment changed only the notes of item 2. Window: the regulation 8 date.
